title: WATCH: China Coast Guard vessel rams BFAR ship off Palawan
summary: Watch the video of China’s latest harassment of a Philippine vessel.

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — A China Coast Guard vessel rammed a BFAR ship while it was on a mission to deliver fuel to Filipino fishermen off Palawan.
The Philippine Coast Guard said CCG-21585 rammed the BRP Datu Magat Salamat at around 11:13 a.m. on Friday, September 18.
Before the collision, the Chinese vessel passed behind the BFAR ship at a distance of about 10 meters.
